svg.title: How do you usually arrange a room?
Two people talk about the room they share.
svg.text: Two people talk about the room they share.

text.tspan: An open question that invites a person to
How do you usually arrange a room?
How do you usually ...? asks about a habit.
Answer the question, then ask a related
A: How do you usually arrange a room?
B: I put a chair near the window.
A: Where do you keep your books?
B: On a shelf beside the chair.
A: Why do you put them there?
B: I can reach them easily.
A: Would you like a plant by the window?
B: Yes. That would be nice.
Your example. Write a reply of your own, then
